card.name: Journey and exploration metaphors in essays
card.fires_on: Small words like my, a, and, you, or beginning inside passages that describe setting out, exploring or journeying, often as a metaphor for learning. It marks the spot just before an equipment or travel word.

modes.label: Gear being carried
modes.description: A small word right before items carried on an expedition or into a fight.
modes.example: working with my machete and carrying<< my>> torch, as I put new territories on

modes.label: Starting out on a new field
modes.description: Words about beginning to explore new ground, used as a metaphor for learning.
modes.example: Identify some<< starting>> points for a more in-depth look into

modes.label: Facing unknown territory
modes.description: A pronoun or article in a scene of facing a new unknown land.
modes.example: Imagine that you’re facing a new mysterious continent.<< You>> know nothing about it.

card.writes: It pushes toward travel words such as travel, traveler, travelled and equipment.
card.plain: It fires on small words in passages about setting out on a journey or exploring, just before travel or gear words.
